newsitem.title: UK: GB Railways shares set debut premium.
newsitem.headline: GB Railways shares set debut premium.

text.p: Shares in rail operator GB Railways Plc were marked sharply higher on their first day of trading on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on Monday.
By 1420 GMT the shares were quoted at 215-1/2p, more than double their 100p issue price, though no trades were recorded in the stock.

A spokesman at Guinness Mahon, adviser to the issue, said the high premium reflected the performance of shares in the only other pure rail operator in the market, Prism Rail, and the relatively low liquidity of stocks on AIM.
He added that the small number of shares available, with the company's founder-directors retaining 25 percent of the capital, had also helped squeeze the price higher.
The float raised a net 6.3 million stg for GB Railways and valued the company at 8.75 million stg. GB Railways holds the train operating franchise for Anglia Railways.
